name: codex-windows-rescue
description: Safely diagnose and recover Codex on Windows, including proxy port drift and an offline emergency audit when Desktop and CLI cannot load the plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Windows Codex diagnosis and recovery
interface.longDescription: Diagnose Windows Codex layer by layer, check system-proxy and local-listener port alignment before broader WebSocket troubleshooting, migrate safely from API or cc-switch setups to ChatGPT sign-in, inspect version-aware Chrome installation and runtime failures, generate redacted reports, and salvage transcript files without merging old task databases. The repository also includes a standalone offline-capable read-only emergency audit for situations where neither Desktop nor CLI can host the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose my Windows Codex problem without changing anything first, including whether the configured proxy port matches the actual local listener.
Help me migrate from API or cc-switch to ChatGPT sign-in safely.
Check why Codex Chrome control cannot connect and distinguish installation from runtime failures.
